entries.reasoning: The new contract provides AI-based analytics and dashboards to a Hospitality Business (BlueOrchid) for properties located in Dubai (UAE) and Muscat (Oman), which are states within the GCC. Al Noor Clause 12.2 expressly includes services relating to properties in the GCC irrespective of where the services are performed.

incomingClauses.quote: AtliQ shall deliver a guest review analytics solution for all twelve (12) Properties listed in Annexure B, comprising: (a) automated ingestion of guest reviews from up to six (6) online sources and BlueOrchid's post-stay survey tool; (b) multilingual sentiment and aspect analysis (English, Hindi, Arabic) covering room, cleanliness, F&B, service, location and value; (c) property-level and portfolio-level dashboards in Power BI for General Managers, the Guest Experience team and senior management
Each Party warrants that it has full power and authority to enter into this Agreement.

entries.suggestedChange: Modify Annexure B to exclude Property No. 10 (BlueOrchid Dubai Business Bay), No. 11 (Orchid Residences Dubai Marina), and No. 12 (BlueOrchid Muscat Qurum).
entries.waiverWhy: The Al Noor waiver is strictly limited to demand-forecasting services for Seaside Hotels LLC and explicitly states it does not extend to any other Hospitality Business.
entries.impact: collides with the Al Noor promise, live until Sep 2029

covenants.impact: The new contract does not contain non-compete, exclusivity, or other restrictive covenants that would limit AtliQ's ability to serve existing clients.
